svg.title: From Mining Rig to AI Rental Rig
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-mining-rig-to-rental-rig; chapter number: 1; title: From Mining Rig to AI Rental Rig; subtitle: Five operator steps before a card earns rental income; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Test the used GPU in person; value: Step 1; detail: Test before paying, price-check on gpudeals.net, seat the 12V cable fully and run a 14-gauge power cable.; step: 02; label: Size power at 80% load; value: Step 2; detail: PSUs, PDUs and rack circuits sized to sit at a consistent 80% load.; step: 03; label: Stress test 48 hours to a week; value: Step 3; detail: Run the C-Payne stress tool and watch for throttling, such as a 4090 dropping from 450 W to 230 W.; step: 04; label: Pin the CPU clock and power floor; value: Step 4; detail: Locking a 7950X at 1600 MHz cut system draw from 600 W to 318 W; never power-limit below 90% on Salad.; step: 05; label: List on a rental marketplace; value: Step 5; detail: Vast takes about 25%, SimplePod 20%, Salad 10% plus 40 cents; a 4090 on Salad nets about $2.92 a day.; caption: Operators who left crypto mining agree the money now sits in renting VRAM, and every step guards that rental income.; assumptions note: Step order is an editorial sequence of separate practitioner gates; fee splits and the $2.92 daily net are as reported, not recomputed.; note: Sources: Modern Mining (WJnsgbZsg0U), Alec Glover (CgsDEFaGLJ0, iuLuDflfEE4), BearMarketMiner (egH5hKD913Y).

text.title: From Mining Rig to AI Rental Rig
text.tspan: From Mining Rig to AI Rental Rig

rect.title: step: 01; label: Test the used GPU in person; value: Step 1; detail: Test before paying, price-check on gpudeals.net, seat the 12V cable fully and run a 14-gauge power cable.

text.title: Test the used GPU in person
Test before paying, price-check on gpudeals.net, seat the 12V cable fully and run a 14-gauge power cable.

rect.title: step: 02; label: Size power at 80% load; value: Step 2; detail: PSUs, PDUs and rack circuits sized to sit at a consistent 80% load.

text.title: PSUs, PDUs and rack circuits sized to sit at a consistent 80% load.

rect.title: step: 03; label: Stress test 48 hours to a week; value: Step 3; detail: Run the C-Payne stress tool and watch for throttling, such as a 4090 dropping from 450 W to 230 W.

text.title: Stress test 48 hours to a week
Run the C-Payne stress tool and watch for throttling, such as a 4090 dropping from 450 W to 230 W.

rect.title: step: 04; label: Pin the CPU clock and power floor; value: Step 4; detail: Locking a 7950X at 1600 MHz cut system draw from 600 W to 318 W; never power-limit below 90% on Salad.

text.title: Pin the CPU clock and power floor
Locking a 7950X at 1600 MHz cut system draw from 600 W to 318 W; never power-limit below 90% on Salad.

rect.title: step: 05; label: List on a rental marketplace; value: Step 5; detail: Vast takes about 25%, SimplePod 20%, Salad 10% plus 40 cents; a 4090 on Salad nets about $2.92 a day.

text.title: Vast takes about 25%, SimplePod 20%, Salad 10% plus 40 cents; a 4090 on Salad nets about $2.92 a day.
Assumptions: Step order is an editorial sequence of separate practitioner gates; fee splits and the $2.92 daily net are as reported, not recomputed.
